test_title: PYST 6: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Apart from income tax, there will also be TDS at ______ and gift tax on digital assets to be paid by the receiver, depending on certain conditions.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• While presenting the Union Budget 2022, Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said there will be a **1% tax deductible at source on such transactions, and gifts of such assets will be taxed.**
 
• Any income from the transfer of any virtual digital asset shall be taxed at 30%.
 
• No deductions and exemptions are allowed.
 
• Also, loss from the transfer of such assets cannot be set off against any other income.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Under the **Income-tax Act, 1961**, **gifts made to specified relatives or made on specific occasions are exempted from tax **irrespective of the amount of gift.
 
• As per tax experts, the definition of **'property'** is to be expanded under the Income-tax Act **to include virtual digital assets** for the taxation of gifts as per the Budget 2022 proposal.
 
• The Budget 2022 proposes to include **virtual digital assets within the scope of moveable assets. **
 
• Thus, **gifting of any virtual digital asset (like Bitcoin or NFT) will be taxable if the value of annual gifts exceeds Rs. 50,000**. 
 
• However, **no tax will be levied if the virtual digital assets are received as a gift from specified relatives** (parents, siblings, children, grandparents, grandchildren, parents-in-law, etc.) **or on the occasion of marriage**.
